releaseNotes:
Release Notes and Important Information

## Before You Update
- Always back up your projects BEFORE updating.
- This update improves SiticoneDataGridView with important fixes, smoother rendering, and new business-ready features.
- Selection color behavior is now more reliable and consistent across rows.
- The unwanted row auto-scroll on selection has been removed.
- Rendering has been refined for a smoother and more stable experience.
- New optional business features have been added and can be enabled only when needed.
- Review the release notes BEFORE updating.
- Contact support if you have questions BEFORE updating.

## Improvements

- Added new professional theme presets to give developers more ready-to-use visual styles for business, enterprise, finance, healthcare, legal, retail, logistics, and modern software interfaces.

- Exposed more theme color properties, making it easier to customize the grid background, headers, rows, selection colors, hover colors, borders, and empty-state visuals without needing custom painting.

- Improved column reordering so dragged columns land more precisely where the user expects.

- Added row reordering support, allowing users to drag rows into a new position when this feature is enabled.

- Added row and column drag ghosting, so users can clearly see what they are moving during reorder operations.

- Improved the drag ghost so it can appear above nested row controls such as buttons, checkboxes, toggles, dropdowns, and other hosted controls.

- Added separate customization options for row drag ghosts and column drag ghosts, including opacity and visual styling.

- Added clearer drop-position indicators for rows and columns, making it easier to see where the dragged item will land.

- Improved the default drop indicator background so it is semi-transparent, allowing users to still see the row or column beneath the target area.

- Added customization options for row and column drop indicator fill opacity, border opacity, and border thickness.

- Kept drop indicator borders solid by default for better visibility and a cleaner drag-and-drop experience.

- Added stronger border customization options for headers, row headers, cell borders, and the main control border.

- Improved row separator line rendering so row lines stay aligned correctly while scrolling.

- Added precise row separator painting to prevent visual line interference when the grid is scrolled.

- Added support for hosting lightweight nested controls inside rows, including buttons, checkboxes, toggle-style controls, and developer-supplied custom controls.

- Added public methods to add, remove, clear, and refresh nested row controls.

- Added comprehensive public events for nested row controls, including button clicks, checkbox changes, toggle changes, mouse actions, double-clicks, and value changes.

- Added richer row, cell, header, drag, reorder, and nested-control event data so developers can easily access row values, bound data, DataRow information, column details, cell details, and mouse information.

- Added native cell interaction events for common grid actions such as cell clicks, cell selection, cell content clicks, and cell value changes.

- Added header interaction events for row headers and column headers.

- Added drag lifecycle events for rows and columns, including drag starting, drag started, dragging, drag completing, drag completed, and reorder completed.

- Improved clipboard, export, formatting, summary, and context menu support for business-oriented usage scenarios.

- Added optional status badge rendering for columns that represent states such as active, pending, warning, failed, or neutral.

- Added optional summary footer support for quick business summaries such as count, sum, average, minimum, and maximum.

- Improved empty-state handling so the grid presents a cleaner message when no data is available.

- Improved handle-safe behavior for nested row controls so they can be refreshed safely when the form handle is ready.

- Preserved backward compatibility by keeping existing public APIs intact and adding new functionality through additional properties, methods, and events.

- Maintained C# 7.3 compatibility for developers using older .NET Framework and WinForms projects.

## Important Usage Notes

- SiticoneDataGridView is primarily designed for displaying tabular data.
- Rich nested controls should be used only when necessary and in small amounts.
- Adding many hosted controls inside a DataGridView can reduce performance because the grid is optimized for data display, not heavy interactive layouts.
- For large editing workflows, it is better to open a dedicated form, panel, or detail screen instead of placing many interactive controls directly inside the grid.
- Row and column drag ghosting, drop indicators, nested controls, status badges, summaries, and context menus are optional features and should be enabled only when they are useful for the application.
